names() returns ['vscode', 'claude-code'] for the default registry.
Registering a duplicate name throws a descriptive error.

All types are exported from the package entry point.

comments.note: src/targets/built-in.ts imports DEFAULT_FRONTMATTER_VSCODE / DEFAULT_FRONTMATTER_CLAUDE_CODE from src/builders/frontmatter.ts, creating a targets → builders cross-layer dependency. When later WPs refactor frontmatter resolution to consult the TargetRegistry, care must be taken to avoid a circular dependency if builders/frontmatter.ts also starts importing from targets/. One safe resolution: move the two default frontmatter constants to src/targets/types.ts or a new src/targets/frontmatter-defaults.ts so they are owned by the targets layer.

TargetRegistry._definitions is a Map, which preserves insertion order — this makes names() deterministic and matches the acceptance criterion. This is intentional but not documented. Adding a brief comment in registry.ts would save future readers from second-guessing whether the order guarantee is accidental.

allDefinitions() returns direct references to the internal Map values — callers can mutate registered TargetDefinition objects at runtime. Acceptable for a build-time tool, but a defensive Array copy (Array.from(this._definitions.values()).map(d => ({...d}))) would eliminate the risk if the registry ever runs in a long-lived server context.

register() accepts an empty-string name without validation — registry.register({ name: '', ... }) succeeds silently. Not a current risk (built-in names are constants, consumers are developers), but adding a guard (if (!definition.name) throw ...) would make misuse more detectable.

Cross-layer dependency flagged by Developer: src/targets/built-in.ts imports DEFAULT_FRONTMATTER_VSCODE / DEFAULT_FRONTMATTER_CLAUDE_CODE from src/builders/frontmatter.ts (targets → builders). If a later WP makes builders/ import from targets/ the cycle will fail at runtime. Mitigation: move those constants to src/targets/types.ts or a new src/targets/frontmatter-defaults.ts before that WP lands.
